content.short: StableFlow moves stablecoins between chains at scale with fast, low-cost transfers.
content.description: StableFlow is a cross-chain transfer app built specifically for stablecoins, letting users pick a source and destination chain and move funds at scale with competitive pricing. Stable's official ecosystem page lists StableFlow.
content.meta: StableFlow moves stablecoins across chains quickly and cheaply, listed in Stable's ecosystem.
